---
title: "How do a biplane variant's stall speed and top speed compare with the monoplane's?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 149.1      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Solved performance for the biplane variant
sigma_cellule = 0.435  # Prandtl mutual interference factor for h/b = 0.216
stall_bi = find_stall_speed(airplane, mass=MASS_AUW, sigma=sigma_cellule)
v_stall_bi_kmh = stall_bi["v_stall_kmh"]
v_stall_bi_ms = stall_bi["v_stall"]
cl_max_bi = stall_bi["cl_max"]
cla_ratio_bi = stall_bi["cla_ratio"]

top_bi = find_top_speed_apc(airplane, mass=MASS_AUW, sigma=sigma_cellule, v_oc=11.1)
v_top_bi_kmh = top_bi["v_top_kmh"]
v_top_bi_ms = top_bi["v_top"]
t_top_bi = top_bi["thrust"]
d_top_bi = top_bi["drag"]

# Baseline monoplane values
# Monoplane top speed solved in 01-airframe-reconstruction/2026-10-02-03-what-top-speed-results-once-propeller-thrust-lapse-is-calibrated
v_top_mono_kmh = 150.4
v_top_mono_ms = v_top_mono_kmh / 3.6
mass_mono = 0.222
cl_max_mono = 0.922
w_mono = mass_mono * 9.80665
rho = 1.225
v_stall_mono_ms = float(np.sqrt(2.0 * w_mono / (rho * airplane.s_ref * cl_max_mono)))
v_stall_mono_kmh = v_stall_mono_ms * 3.6

# Relative differences
v_top_delta_kmh = v_top_bi_kmh - v_top_mono_kmh
v_top_delta_pct = (v_top_delta_kmh / v_top_mono_kmh) * 100
v_stall_delta_kmh = v_stall_bi_kmh - v_stall_mono_kmh
v_stall_delta_pct = (v_stall_delta_kmh / v_stall_mono_kmh) * 100
mass_delta_g = (MASS_AUW - mass_mono) * 1e3
mass_delta_pct = ((MASS_AUW - mass_mono) / mass_mono) * 100

# Airspeed sweep for visual comparison
v_sweep = np.linspace(15.0, 48.0, 24)
drag_bi_sweep = np.array([level_flight_drag(airplane, v, mass=MASS_AUW, sigma=sigma_cellule) for v in v_sweep])
thrust_sweep = np.array([solve_propulsion_thrust_apc(v, v_oc=11.1)["thrust"] for v in v_sweep])

# Angle of attack sweep for lift curves
alphas = np.linspace(0.0, 16.0, 20)
c_mac = airplane.c_ref
re_stall = 10.0 * c_mac / 1.5e-5
aero_sec = asb.Airfoil("naca2404").get_aero_from_neuralfoil(alpha=alphas, Re=re_stall)
cl_mono_curve = np.array(aero_sec["CL"])
cl_bi_curve = cl_mono_curve * cla_ratio_bi
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{v_stall_bi_kmh:.1f} / {v_top_bi_kmh:.1f} km/h"`]{.hero-value}
[Biplane variant stall speed and level-flight top speed]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** With equal total wing area and unchanged 3S powertrain, the biplane variant reaches [`{python} f"{v_top_bi_kmh:.1f} km/h"`]{.key} top speed—dropping only [`{python} f"{abs(v_top_delta_kmh):.1f} km/h"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{abs(v_top_delta_pct):.1f}%"`]{.key}) from the [monoplane's calibrated speed](../01-airframe-reconstruction/2026-10-02-03-what-top-speed-results-once-propeller-thrust-lapse-is-calibrated.qmd)—because near-zero lift at high speed makes induced drag negligible (@fig-stall-top-comparison). In contrast, the additional [`{python} f"{mass_delta_g:.0f} g"`]{.key} panel mass ([`{python} f"{mass_delta_pct:+.1f}%"`]{.key}) and mutual downwash lower usable $C_{L,\max}$ from [`{python} f"{cl_max_mono:.3f}"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{cl_max_bi:.3f}"`]{.key}. This increases stall speed from [`{python} f"{v_stall_mono_kmh:.1f} km/h"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{v_stall_bi_kmh:.1f} km/h"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{v_stall_delta_kmh:+.1f} km/h"`]{.key}, [`{python} f"{v_stall_delta_pct:+.1f}%"`]{.key}).

```{python}
#| label: fig-stall-top-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Lift curves and stall points (left) alongside level-flight drag and available APC thrust (right) for the biplane variant versus the monoplane."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(7.5, 3.8))

idx_stall_peak = 8
ax1.plot(alphas, cl_mono_curve, "r--", lw=1.8, label=f"Monoplane ($V_{{stall}}={v_stall_mono_kmh:.1f}$ km/h)")
ax1.plot(alphas, cl_bi_curve, "b-", lw=2, label=f"Biplane ($V_{{stall}}={v_stall_bi_kmh:.1f}$ km/h)")
ax1.plot(alphas[idx_stall_peak], cl_mono_curve[idx_stall_peak], "ro", ms=5)
ax1.plot(alphas[idx_stall_peak], cl_bi_curve[idx_stall_peak], "bo", ms=5)
ax1.set_xlabel("Angle of attack $\\alpha$ [deg]")
ax1.set_ylabel("Lift coefficient $C_L$ [-]")
ax1.set_xlim(0, 16)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1.1)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=8)

v_sweep_kmh = v_sweep * 3.6
ax2.plot(v_sweep_kmh, drag_bi_sweep, "b-", lw=2, label="Biplane drag ($L=W$)")
ax2.plot(v_sweep_kmh, thrust_sweep, "k-", lw=1.8, label="APC 6x4.5E thrust")
ax2.plot(v_top_bi_kmh, top_bi["thrust"], "bo", ms=6, label=f"Biplane ($V_{{top}}={v_top_bi_kmh:.1f}$ km/h)")
ax2.axvline(v_top_mono_kmh, color="r", linestyle="--", lw=1.5, label=f"Monoplane ({v_top_mono_kmh:.1f} km/h)")
ax2.set_xlabel("Airspeed [km/h]")
ax2.set_ylabel("Force [N]")
ax2.set_xlim(50, 175)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 4.0)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax2.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
